tasks.label: build-solution
args: & dotnet build 'Bulk Solution Exporter.sln' -c Debug; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $plugins = "$env:APPDATA\MscrmTools\XrmToolBox\Plugins"; try { Copy-Item 'Bulk Solution Exporter\bin\Debug\Plugins\Com.AiricLenz.XTB.Plugin.BulkSolutionExporter.dll' "$plugins\Com.AiricLenz.XTB.Plugin.BulkSolutionExporter.dll" -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Copy-Item 'Bulk Solution Exporter\bin\Debug\Plugins\Com.AiricLenz.BulkSolutionExporter.Core.dll' "$plugins\Com.AiricLenz.BulkSolutionExporter.Core.dll" -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Copy-Item 'Bulk Solution Exporter\bin\Debug\System.Resources.Extensions.dll' "$plugins\System.Resources.Extensions.dll" -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Error ('Deploy copy failed: ' + $_); exit 1 }; exit 0
